subject: math
description: Define circular segments, compare them with sectors, and find segment areas by subtracting triangle area from sector area.
learningObjectives: Define a circular segment as the region between a chord and its intercepted arc
Compare circular segments with sectors using boundaries and included regions
Identify the sector and triangle that form a circular segment
Find sector area using the central angle and radius
Find segment area by subtracting triangle area from sector area
prerequisites: Recognizing parts of a circle such as radius, chord, arc, and central angle
Using the area formula for a circle
Using the area formula for a triangle
